title: Geologic map of the Mount Holly quadrangle, Berkeley and Charleston Counties, South Carolina
citation: Weems, R.E., and Lemon, E.M., 1984, Geologic map of the Mount Holly quadrangle, Berkeley and Charleston Counties, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQ-1579, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Page 3 is OCR of the full map sheet; the text column is clean. Pages 1-2 are the cover and a standard symbol sheet. Unit symbols in the legend boxes are partly lost; most symbols are taken from the auger-log column or text (flagged inferred; OCR Qte/Qic/Teb read as Qtc/Qlc/Tcb). Auger-hole surface elevations are matched to holes by column order in the log header (flagged inferred); log intervals are not legible. Parkers Ferry thickness is cut off in OCR. The Marks Head age ~15 Ma and the Penholoway age about 1,000,000 ± 250,000 years differ from later sheets (as printed).
